title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin slipped to seventy-five thousand eight hundred fifty-five at the US close, down one point one percent on the day as fear and greed hit extreme fear at twenty-five. The market is signaling caution despite hashrate holding firm at nine hundred forty EH/s and block production steady at height nine five one one nine eight. Mempool congestion sits at one hundred seventeen thousand transactions with fees as low as two sat per vbyte, showing steady demand but limited urgency.
